title: Verify CME Corporate Account Creation
description: End-to-end verification of corporate onboarding flow via CME web portal.

steps.action: Log in using StandardUser credentials and navigate to CME Account module
steps.expectedResult: User lands on CME Account Management home view with Active status

steps.action: Click "+ New Corporate Customer" button and enter valid company registration details
steps.expectedResult: Form validates company fields, tax ID, and address correctly

steps.action: Select Risk Level "Standard" and click Submit
steps.expectedResult: System returns generated Account Reference ID with Pending Approval status
